newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai money market closes on Chulalongkorn Day.
newsitem.headline: Thai money market closes on Chulalongkorn Day.

text.p: Thai banks and money market closed on Wednesday on a public holiday to observe the Chulalongkorn Day.
The Thai overnight interbank rate fell to 11.50-12.00 percent on late Tuesday from 13.00 in the morning on improved liquidity after commercial banks met cash reserve requirements.

"With the reserve deadline behind, most banks have more excess funds to lend out," said a dealer at a Thai bank on Tuesday. Dealers expect liquidity to rise further on Thursday when banks reopen due to a limited demand of market funds.
